thread:
maya: Quick micro-standup — SDK quickstarts + sampleapp.

maya: Yesterday: updated Node quickstart with ES module notes, fixed Windows packaging edge-case in sampleapp.
Blocker: CI flakes on macOS wheel build.
Today: follow up on PRs and push a tiny CI fix.

liam: Pulled latest, saw tests failing in sampleapp when AUTH_TOKEN env is missing. Adding guard + test. PR #482: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/482

sasha: @liam can you rebase onto main? CI retry isn't picking up the new matrix changes we merged earlier. I'll hold off merge until green. :thumbsup:

tom: Quick ping — can someone review my docs examples for the embed endpoint? Small changes, 3 files. PR #489.

jen: Heads up — release automation updated: the GitHub action now needs a repo:write token for the packages step. I added the new secret to org vault. If you see deploy bot fail, ping me and I'll check perms.

pr-bot: CI: build failed on macos-latest for sampleapp. Error excerpt: "wheel build failed: could not find cmake". Full log: https://ci.internal/xyz/logs/1865432158

liam: Blocker for me — mac runner missing cmake. Options: 1) install cmake via brew in workflow, 2) add binary artifact, 3) tweak build to avoid cmake. Leaning toward brew install to keep it simple.

maya: I'll open PR with a small workflow patch to brew install cmake before wheel build and re-run CI. Also will add a short note to the quickstart README about mac build prerequisites.

sasha: I'll review tom's PR after lunch and take another look at #482 once the rebase is done.

tom: thanks! also added a tiny helper script to regenerate example prompts: ./scripts/gen_prompts.sh — just FYI in case you run examples locally.

maya: Sounds good. I'll send PRs: #491 (ci: macos cmake), #492 (docs: quickstart mac note). Once CI passes we can merge the docs and sampleapp fixes. :rocket:

jen: Thanks — once those PRs land I'll kick a release draft and run the deploy dry-run.

maya: Closing loop for today. Ping here if anything blocks merge or release.
